title: Interest reconciliation failed
description: This event occurs when a reconciliation request cannot be processed with product interest management.

external_operation_id.title: External operation ID
external_operation_id.description: Identifier sent by the client in the external_id field of the reconciliation request.

operation_date.title: Operation date
operation_date.description: Operation date, represents the day being closed.

reason_code.title: Reason code
reason_code.description: Code of the business rule that refused the request: DAILY_CLOSURE_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_OPERATION_DATE, INVALID_STEP, STEP_IN_PROGRESS or DAILY_CLOSURE_OUTDATED.

message.title: Error message
message.description: Description of the error that occurred when processing the request
examples: new transactions were found after DAILY_CLOSURE for operation_date 2026-10-20, run DAILY_CLOSURE again
